Yuki Tsunoda's teammates from 2021 to 2025 were Pierre Gasly (2021–22), Nyck de Vries and Daniel Ricciardo (2023), Ricciardo and Liam Lawson (2024), and Max Verstappen (2025, at Red Bull). The search results confirm Tsunoda's partnerships with Verstappen at Red Bull in 2025 and with Gasly at AlphaTauri in 2021, but they don't list every teammate change, so the rest of the roster comes from my own knowledge of those seasons.

Of these, only Max Verstappen won a drivers' championship (2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024). None of the others did.

ANSWER: Max Verstappen
